question: Where should the mudrā named prārthanā be placed when performed?
premises: The mudrā is to be made by the practitioner.
Its placement is on one’s own heart.
It is designated by the name prārthanā.
inference: The prārthanā mudrā is performed by placing it on one’s own heart.
plain_english: One should make this mudrā on one’s own heart; it is called the Prārthanā mudrā.
